name: Giant Steps
description: Clock-driven chord sequencer over Coltrane tonal center geometry

sections.heading: Faders
items: Main — approach density in 7 steps: adds one approach chord at a time (V of each center, then ii of each center), growing the cycle from 3 to 9 chords on a fixed 9-slot grid
Third (Btn hold) — Feel: swing and velocity dynamics, bottom = straight and flat

sections.heading: Buttons
items: Short tap — mute (silences held chords, parks CV at 0 V)
Shift + hold — cycle Interval: minor 3rd, major 3rd, 4th, tritone

sections.heading: Signal / LEDs
items: Three tonal center hues rotated around the app colour — LED shows the current center
CV Out tracks root pitch of the current step
CV In Density modulates approach depth; CV In Reset triggers cycle reset on rising edge
Button ducks briefly on each chord trigger
Reverse fades the button white to none; Interval flashes one colour per step

channels.jackDescription: CV Out sends the root pitch of the current cycle step and parks at 0 V while muted. CV In Density modulates the approach depth; CV In Reset triggers a cycle reset on rising edge.
channels.faderDescription: Approach depth in 7 positions on a fixed 9-slot grid — three slots (ii, V, I) per tonal center. The I of each center always plays; raising the fader inserts one approach chord at a time, first the V of centers 1–3, then the ii of centers 1–3, so the cycle grows 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9 chords. Empty slots aren’t silent: the previous chord sustains through them, so loop length and bar alignment stay constant and sparse settings give a long held tonic.
channels.faderPlusFnDescription: Humanises the sequence: swings the off-beats and shapes velocity, accenting the tonic while approach chords lighten. Bottom is straight and flat.
channels.fnDescription: Short tap mutes and unmutes, cutting any held chord. Hold toggles the reverse flag, inverting Forward/Reverse direction.
channels.fnPlusShiftDescription: Shift + tap resets the cycle to step 0. Shift + hold cycles the Interval between minor 3rd, major 3rd, 4th and tritone.
